_comment: Day tickets for regional trains in Germany (2nd class), copied by hand from the official DB pages. Prices change; the owner re-checks them before each release and updates checked_on. price = price_first + price_extra * (persons - 1). children_6_14_free_max: how many children aged 6-14 ride free with the ticket (0 means they count as persons). Children under 6 always ride free. weekday_valid_from: earliest start Monday to Friday (null = all day). Not included yet: Mecklenburg-Vorpommern-Ticket (prices differ by weekday).

deutschlandticket.name: Deutschlandticket
deutschlandticket.notes: Personal monthly subscription for all regional transport in Germany. It does not include children aged 6-14, who need their own ticket. The price rises to 66.80 EUR per month from 2027-01-01; monthly_price is not used in any calculation.

day_tickets.name: Quer-durchs-Land-Ticket
day_tickets.notes: Valid in regional trains in all of Germany.

day_tickets.name: Bayern-Ticket
day_tickets.notes: Also covers some routes just outside Bavaria; check the area on bahn.de.

day_tickets.name: Brandenburg-Berlin-Ticket
day_tickets.notes: One price for up to 5 people.

day_tickets.name: Hessenticket
day_tickets.notes: One price for up to 5 people. Children aged 6-14 count as people and must be written on the ticket.

day_tickets.name: Niedersachsen-Ticket
day_tickets.notes: Valid all day, also before 9:00 on weekdays. Includes Bremen and Hamburg.

day_tickets.name: 24h Ticket NRW 5 Personen
day_tickets.notes: Valid for 24 hours. The person named on the ticket may also take their own children or grandchildren up to 14 free; this app counts at most 3 to stay on the safe side.

day_tickets.name: Rheinland-Pfalz-Ticket / Saarland-Ticket
day_tickets.notes: Check on bahn.de which of the two tickets fits the route.

day_tickets.name: Sachsen-Ticket / Sachsen-Anhalt-Ticket / Thüringen-Ticket
day_tickets.notes: The three tickets cost the same and are valid across Saxony, Saxony-Anhalt and Thuringia.
